answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital inlet for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to solve cryptographic puzzles anchored to unique biological signatures. Much like the resilient roots of a cedar that anchor it firmly, this mechanism ensures one identity per entity. If an attacker attempts to scale, they incur the lotus of compute costs, effectively pricing them out of the network as the expense of verifying fraudulent nodes exceeds any potential gain from manipulation within the consensus model.
